title: Binary Input

fields.label: Purpose
fields.value: Packs binary states into one signal.

"Takes in up to 5 bits of binary, and will output it as a linear signal."

The Binary Input is a logic component that can be purchased from Alan's AutoLogistics. It is used to pack a binary state into a numeric signal.

Functionality

The Bit In is a logic component to pack binary states. It has 5 inputs, each corresponding to a binary digit (1, 2, 4, 8, 16) from right to left. As long as an input has a signal strength above 0, it will be activated. The output combines the binary input into one signal. This signal has a maximum strength of 32 if all inputs have a signal.

Trivia

  • During testing of the Logic system, this was known as the BITINComponent.
